  "issues" : [ {
    "rule" : "DUPLICATE_ID",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "expectationId" : "a",
    "index" : 0,
    "summary" : "GTE users",
    "field" : "id",
    "message" : "is replaced by a later entry with the same id (GET /x?y=1); expectations are upserted by id, so only the last one is kept",
    "relatedExpectationId" : "a",
    "relatedIndex" : 1,
    "relatedSummary" : "GET /x?y=1"
  }, {
    "rule" : "TIME_TO_LIVE_ZERO",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "expectationId" : "a",
    "index" : 1,
    "summary" : "GET /x?y=1",
    "field" : "timeToLive",
    "message" : "never matches: its time to live is 0, so it expires as it is created"
  }, {
    "rule" : "PATH_INCLUDES_QUERY_STRING",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "expectationId" : "a",
    "index" : 1,
    "summary" : "GET /x?y=1",
    "field" : "path",
    "message" : "does not match as written: the query string is not part of the path, and ? is a regex quantifier here; move it to queryStringParameters"
  }, {
    "rule" : "HEADER_NAME_TYPO",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "expectationId" : "a",
    "index" : 1,
    "summary" : "GET /x?y=1",
    "field" : "headers",
    "message" : "header \"Contnet-Type\" is not a standard header name; did you mean Content-Type?"
  }, {
    "rule" : "HEADER_NAME_TYPO",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "expectationId" : "a",
    "index" : 1,
    "summary" : "GET /x?y=1",
    "field" : "headers",
    "message" : "header \"x_request_id\" is not a standard header name; did you mean X-Request-Id?"
  }, {
    "rule" : "PATH_GLOB_WILDCARD",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "index" : 2,
    "summary" : "any method /a/*",
    "field" : "path",
    "message" : "the path is a regular expression, not a glob: * repeats the character before it, so \"/*\" matches any number of slashes, including none, and nothing else; use .* to match any characters"
  }, {
    "rule" : "PERCENTAGE_ZERO",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "index" : 3,
    "summary" : "any method /a/b",
    "field" : "percentage",
    "message" : "never served: percentage is 0, so every matching request passes it over"
  }, {
    "rule" : "UNREACHABLE_RESPONSES",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "index" : 4,
    "summary" : "any method /u/{id}",
    "field" : "httpResponses",
    "message" : "only the first 2 of its 3 responses can be served: times allows 2 matches in SEQUENTIAL mode, so responses 3 to 3 are never reached (except by the x-mockserver-response-index header)"
  }, {
    "rule" : "PATH_TEMPLATE_WITHOUT_PATH_PARAMETERS",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "index" : 4,
    "summary" : "any method /u/{id}",
    "field" : "path",
    "message" : "the path has a {name} template but no pathParameters, so the braces are matched as written; add pathParameters (for example \"name\": [\".*\"]) or use a regex such as [^/]+"
  }, {
    "rule" : "STRICT_JSON_BODY_WITH_ARRAYS",
    "severity" : "INFO",
    "index" : 4,
    "summary" : "any method /u/{id}",
    "field" : "body",
    "message" : "STRICT matching needs every array in the same order with no extra items; if order or extra items should not matter use ONLY_MATCHING_FIELDS (the default)"
  }, {
    "rule" : "PATH_INCLUDES_SCHEME_AND_HOST",
    "severity" : "WARNING",
    "index" : 5,
    "summary" : "any method http://h/x",
    "field" : "path",
    "message" : "never matches: the path is matched without the scheme and host, so write only the part from the first / (match the host with a Host header, or secure for https)"
  }, {
    "rule" : "INVALID_EXPECTATION",
    "severity" : "ERROR",
    "index" : 6,
    "summary" : "5",
    "message" : "not a valid expectation, so PUT /mockserver/expectation would reject it: 8 errors:\n   - $.httpRequest.anyOf: is missing, but is required, if specifying action of type Request.anyOf\n   - $.httpRequest.binaryData: is missing, but is required, if specifying action of type Request.binaryData\n   - $.httpRequest.dnsName: is missing, but is required, if specifying action of type Request.dnsName\n   - $.httpRequest.if: is missing, but is required, if specifying action of type Request.if\n   - $.httpRequest.path: integer found, string expected\n   - $.httpRequest.path: should be valid to one and only one schema, but 0 are valid\n   - $.httpRequest.specUrlOrPayload: is missing, but is required, if specifying OpenAPI request matcher\n   - oneOf of the following must be specified [httpError, httpForward, httpForwardClassCallback, httpForwardObjectCallback, httpForwardTemplate, httpForwardValidateAction, httpForwardWithFallback, httpOverrideForwardedRequest, httpResponse, httpResponseClassCallback, httpResponseObjectCallback, httpResponseTemplate]\n  \n  OpenAPI Specification: https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/jamesdbloom/mock-server-openapi/9.2.x\n  Documentation: https://mock-server.com/mock_server/creating_expectations.html"
  }, {
    "rule" : "INVALID_EXPECTATION",
    "severity" : "ERROR",
    "index" : 8,
    "summary" : "",
    "message" : "not a valid expectation, so PUT /mockserver/expectation would reject it: each entry must be an expectation object"
  } ]
}
